instruction: The two blind-stage records are immutable. Compare them with the now-revealed canonical 1/2/2 selection and complete standalone item. Do not inspect or infer sibling-case material. Return the required Phase-E structured JSON without revising either blind record.

tokens.en: Intensify nutritional support with dietitian follow-up, high-protein supplements, and intake goals
tokens.zh: 通过营养师跟进、高蛋白补充和摄入目标来加强营养支持

tokens.en: Discontinue q2h repositioning because she is now getting out of bed several times daily
tokens.zh: 因患者现在每天能多次下床，停止每2小时翻身

tokens.en: Correct right heel offloading immediately and verify the heel is fully floated at every repositioning
tokens.zh: 立即纠正右足跟减压，并每次翻身确认足跟完全悬空

tokens.en: Simply reposition the same heel boot without inspecting the heel or changing the offloading method
tokens.zh: 只重新摆放同一只足跟保护靴，不检查足跟，也不改变减压方式

tokens.en: Impaired skin integrity with evolving pressure-injury risk, including device-related heel injury
tokens.zh: 皮肤完整性受损并存在进展性压力性损伤风险，包括器械相关足跟损伤

tokens.en: Surgical-site infection causing the skin changes
tokens.zh: 手术切口感染导致皮肤改变

tokens.en: Deep vein thrombosis presenting as lower-extremity skin changes
tokens.zh: 深静脉血栓表现为下肢皮肤改变

tokens.en: Incentive spirometry volumes as the main indicator of pressure-injury healing
tokens.zh: 将激励式肺量计容量作为压力性损伤愈合的主要指标

tokens.en: Hemoglobin trend as the main indicator of skin-plan effectiveness
tokens.zh: 将血红蛋白趋势作为皮肤护理计划效果的主要指标

tokens.en: Meal and supplement intake compared with dietitian calorie/protein goals
tokens.zh: 餐食和补充品摄入量与营养师热量/蛋白目标的比较

tokens.en: Serial skin assessments of coccyx and right heel: size, color, blanchability, warmth, and integrity
tokens.zh: 连续评估尾骨和右足跟皮肤：大小、颜色、可褪色情况、温度和完整性

glossary.defZh: 一种NGN题型，将情况识别与措施及监测参数联系起来。
移除易受损部位所承受的压力。
红斑按压后是否变白，并在松开后恢复的特性。

byChoice.en: This condition integrates the improving sacral Stage 1 injury, the new heel Stage 1 injury, immobility, moisture, nutrition risk, and device pressure.
byChoice.zh: 该诊断整合了正在改善的骶尾部1期损伤、新的足跟1期损伤、不活动、潮湿、营养风险和器械受压。

byChoice.en: The pressure findings are remote from the incision; the incision has no erythema or warmth, the client is afebrile, and WBC is normal.
byChoice.zh: 压力相关发现远离切口；切口无红肿发热，患者无发热，白细胞正常。

byChoice.en: The heel lesion is localized exactly to device contact, with no calf tenderness or diffuse unilateral swelling suggesting DVT.
byChoice.zh: 足跟病灶正好局限于器械接触处，没有提示DVT的小腿压痛或弥漫性单侧肿胀。

byChoice.en: Immediate correction of offloading removes the mechanism causing the new device-related injury.
byChoice.zh: 立即纠正减压方式可移除造成新的器械相关损伤的机制。

byChoice.en: Nutrition support targets persistent poor intake and tissue-tolerance risk that can delay healing.
byChoice.zh: 营养支持针对持续摄入不足和组织耐受性风险，有助于愈合。

byChoice.en: Simply repositioning the same boot treats the device as inherently safe and may allow the strap injury to recur.
byChoice.zh: 只是重新摆放同一只保护靴，把器械视为天然安全，可能让绑带损伤复发。

byChoice.en: Mobility is improving but she still spends much of the day in bed and remains at risk; stopping scheduled turns would expose the sacrum to renewed pressure.
byChoice.zh: 活动虽改善，但患者大部分时间仍在床上且仍有风险；停止定时翻身会让骶尾部再次承受持续压力。

byChoice.en: Serial skin measurements directly show whether pressure offloading and moisture management are working.
byChoice.zh: 连续皮肤测量能直接显示减压和潮湿管理是否有效。

byChoice.en: Intake versus dietitian goals evaluates whether nutrition support is meeting healing demands.
byChoice.zh: 摄入量与营养师目标对比，可评价营养支持是否满足愈合需求。

byChoice.en: Hemoglobin is a postoperative anemia concern but does not evaluate pressure-injury resolution or nutrition-plan effectiveness.
byChoice.zh: 血红蛋白是术后贫血相关问题，但不能评价压力性损伤是否改善或营养计划是否有效。

byChoice.en: Spirometry is important pulmonary care but does not measure skin-integrity or nutrition outcomes.
byChoice.zh: 肺量计使用是重要肺部护理，但不能衡量皮肤完整性或营养结局。

correct.en: The resolved picture is pressure-injury risk with both improvement and failure: the sacral Stage 1 site is smaller, but a new device-related heel Stage 1 injury proves the offloading plan needs modification. Nutrition remains a healing-risk domain. Monitoring should track the actual skin sites and whether nutritional intake meets goals.
correct.zh: 最终图像是压力性损伤风险中既有改善也有失败：骶尾部1期区域缩小，但新的器械相关足跟1期损伤证明减压计划需要调整。营养仍是愈合风险领域。监测应跟踪实际皮肤部位，以及营养摄入是否达到目标。

stem.en: On postoperative day 2 after hip hemiarthroplasty, an 82-year-old client has an improving coccygeal Stage 1 pressure injury, improved mobility and voiding, persistent limited intake, and a new intact non-blanchable right heel area exactly where a shifted heel-suspension boot strap contacted the posterior calcaneus. Complete the bow-tie by choosing the most likely condition, two priority actions, and two parameters to monitor.
stem.zh: 髋关节半置换术后第2天，一名82岁患者尾骨1期压力性损伤正在改善，活动和排尿改善，但摄入仍有限，并在右足跟出现新的完整皮肤不可褪色区域，位置正好是移位足跟悬吊靴绑带接触后跟骨处。请完成蝴蝶结题：选择最可能情况、两个优先措施和两个监测参数。

testTakingStrategy.en: For bow-tie items, match the condition to the finding that explains the whole pattern, then choose actions and parameters that directly change or measure that condition.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做蝴蝶结题时，要让“最可能情况”解释整个模式，然后选择能直接改变或衡量该情况的措施和参数。
